planning.partial_forecast: Lower bound only: missing or incomplete evidence. Uncalibrated quota windows: {{models}}. Do not treat this as sufficient capacity.
planning.mixed_hint: Mixed-model segments allocate quota by API-equivalent spend and contribute alongside single-model segments. This is an approximation, not a provider quota formula; forecasts using it are provisional.
planning.title: Subscription Planning
planning.intro: Plan capacity from recorded tokens and quota consumption, followed by a 30-day projection. These estimates describe your observed workload, not guaranteed provider limits.
planning.unavailable: Planning data is unavailable. Refresh to retry.
planning.coverage: Quota observations since {{date}}. A weekly cycle may not yet be fully observed.
planning.exclusions: {{mixed}} mixed-model intervals available for estimation; {{invalid}} interrupted or incomplete intervals excluded.
planning.forecast_hint: Preserves the current workload split across plan types. Uses median estimated capacity and adds each model’s share of the same quota, then takes the stricter weekly or five-hour requirement. Assumes steady traffic and continuous renewal; bursts, reset timing, routing reserves and provider policy changes can require more capacity. This is not a cheapest-plan optimizer.
planning.insufficient: Not enough matched quota evidence for a reliable estimate.
planning.weekly_only: Weekly estimate only; five-hour capacity is not yet established.
planning.capacity_hint: Matched segments from the last 30 days, each spanning at least two reads and 5 quota percentage points. Tokens from unchanged readings carry forward. Most matched tokens is a lower bound, not a full period. Ceiling is the highest tokens ÷ quota-used × 100; typical capacity is the median across account/reset cycles. Models share quota: ceilings are alternatives, not additive allowances. Cache mix, delayed quota updates and usage outside this proxy affect estimates. Historical usage is grouped by the configured plan type; separate tiers before comparing.
planning.contract_hint: Use distinct plan types for different allowances, e.g. Ultra 20×, Team Pro and Team Std. Annual price is the full yearly charge; Spend Analysis stores its monthly equivalent. Renewal dates describe existing commitments, not automatic cancellations. Team defaults are annual, February 28, 2027; save to confirm. Existing prices are unchanged until saved.
planning.idle: Click Calculate to load recorded data and create a forecast. Server-side usage and quota collection continues independently.
planning.recalculate: Inputs changed. Click Calculate to update the comparison.
planning.no_period_evidence: No observed capacity for this period yet.
planning.optimizer_intro: Compare personal plan capacity for your measured 30-day, 7-day and 5-hour run rates. Use committed subscriptions first, then minimize account count and use price to break ties.
planning.optimizer_idle: Click Calculate to compare all three run rates. Historical token and quota collection continues on the server.
planning.optimizer_scope: Each scenario uses a measured run rate. Costs depend on the plan tiers and quota windows with usable capacity evidence. An incomplete calculation covers only the listed models and cannot establish the cheapest complete plan mix. Routing reserves, traffic bursts and other provider limits can require more capacity.
planning.commitments_hint: Unexpired annual subscriptions and existing Team subscriptions remain committed through their saved expiry date. Disabled accounts retain their cost but supply no capacity. Undated annual contracts stay committed until an expiry is set. Team plans are excluded from renewal and new purchases.
planning.recorded_hours: Rate based on {{hours}} recorded hours. Day ranges end at local midnight; the five-hour range ends at Calculate.
planning.partial_history: History is shorter than this range, has gaps, or contains incomplete records. The measured rate uses the available recorded duration; any plan mix is provisional.
planning.missing_calibration: Some models lack usable capacity evidence: {{models}}.
planning.solve_insufficient: Purchase recommendation withheld: insufficient demand or capacity evidence.
planning.solve_unsolved: No verified feasible allocation was found. No purchase recommendation is available.
planning.solve_optimal: Lowest modeled cost among the entered plan tiers, conditional on the capacity estimates.
planning.solve_limited: A feasible mix was found before the calculation time limit; lowest cost has not been established.
planning.recommendations: Plan mix for this run rate
planning.actual_by_model: Recorded consumption and run rate by model
planning.calibration_hint: Estimated tokens per full quota allowance from recorded usage and measured quota drops. For mixed evidence, each model shows its highest observed allowance within a whole workload, not a standalone quota; the optimizer preserves those shared workloads. Mixed-only models need at least two observations and ten metered calls. API prices are not used.
planning.purchase_prices: These are actual existing contract costs, including any tax already paid. Annual commitments are retained; monthly accounts can be retained up to the current count. Additional purchases use the refreshed public catalog, selected capacity matches and tax rate. No account changes or purchases are performed.
planning.tax_hint: Default: Austin, Texas · 8.25%. Calculate remembers your last rate in this browser. Tax is an estimate applied to published purchase prices; existing contract amounts are already your actual costs.
planning.invalid_tax: Enter a tax rate from 0 to 100.
planning.price_error: Could not refresh prices. The last loaded catalog is unchanged.
planning.match_hint: Calculate once to load your historical plan tiers. Match a published plan only to evidence for the same capacity tier. Renamed or changed tiers are not matched automatically. Unmatched plans cannot be recommended. Prices show monthly equivalents; annual options require an annual purchase.
planning.source_unavailable: Current prices could not be read reliably. Open the official source; this provider has no imported purchase options.
planning.preserve_contract: Saved price retained; selecting a published plan replaces it.
planning.no_published_options: No published plans available for this provider. Refresh published plans.
planning.selection_hint: Choose the published plan for each account and save. The plan supplies its name, price, and billing period.
planning.catalog_hint: Choose these plans directly in Account plans below. Capacity is linked automatically by provider and plan tier; no separate matching is required.
planning.solve_partial: Partial calculation: only models with measured capacity are included. Other models still need quota history. These costs are not a complete budget; cancellation recommendations are withheld.
planning.catalog_price_hint: Monthly-equivalent catalog prices before tax; saved selections include the tax rate above.
planning.conservative_notice: Mixed-use estimates keep each observed workload together and charge its quota once. The optimizer can combine observed mixes; it cannot add their per-model ceilings independently. Different cache mixes and limited quota history still make these estimates provisional.
planning.shared_plans_hint: One place to manage published subscription plans, prices, tax, and cost visibility for Spend Analysis and Subscription Planning.
planning.purchase_policy: Purchase preference: individual plans (Pro, Max, Ultra and other personal tiers). Keep existing Team commitments until expiry; do not buy or renew Team plans. Prefer the fewest accounts, then the lowest cost. Only tiers with usable capacity evidence can be recommended.
planning.solve_fewest_optimal: Fewest modeled accounts, then lowest cost at that count, conditional on the capacity estimates.
planning.solve_fewest_limited: A feasible allocation was found, but the fewest-account or lowest-cost tie-break search did not finish.
planning.quota_period_basis: Quota renews every 7 days (168 hours), plus a 5-hour limit where present. The 5-hour scenario uses only that burst against the weekly allowance. Longer histories use average consumption per quota period. Monthly equivalent is the billing cost.
planning.solve_unvalidated: Capacity estimate failed the historical check. It cannot reproduce recorded usage with the accounts that served it, so additional purchases and cancellations are not calculated from this estimate.
planning.serving_accounts_hint: Actual metered usage, grouped once per plan and billing cycle using current plan assignments. This is the observed fleet, not a purchase recommendation or proof of repeatable capacity. Resets, plan changes and incomplete quota history can prevent reconciliation.
planning.forecast_intro: Next month’s subscriptions from your daily token burn and measured quota use.
planning.no_forecast_data: No recorded quota use for these models yet.

trustedProxies.label: Trusted proxies
trustedProxies.hint: IP addresses or CIDRs; empty means forwarded headers are not trusted. Trusting all-address ranges risks client IP spoofing. Requires a backend restart.

discoveryEnabled.label: Enable discovery
discoveryEnabled.hint: Broadcast via mDNS / DNS-SD on the LAN. Off by default; changes apply without a restart.

discoveryServiceName.label: Service name prefix
discoveryServiceName.hint: The backend appends a short ID. Empty uses CPA-<ShortID>.

discoverySubtypes.label: Protocol subtypes
discoverySubtypes.hint: Empty uses the five default protocols. Missing leading _ is added; invalid entries are ignored.

discoveryInterfacesInclude.label: Include interfaces
discoveryInterfacesInclude.hint: Empty auto-selects physical LAN interfaces. Use names or prefix patterns ending in *.

discoveryInterfacesExclude.label: Exclude interfaces
discoveryInterfacesExclude.hint: Use names or prefix patterns ending in *. Exclusions take priority over inclusions.

discoveryAuthRequired.label: Advertise authentication requirement
discoveryAuthRequired.hint: On by default. Broadcast metadata only; does not change actual API authentication.

discoveryAdvertiseManagement.label: Advertise management service
discoveryAdvertiseManagement.hint: Off by default. Only announces the management service exists; does not change remote access permissions.

serverExtras.discoveryHint: Requires multicast-capable physical interfaces and a non-loopback listener. Docker usually needs host networking; reachability is not guaranteed.

additions.oauthHint: These provider settings apply only to OAuth/file-backed credentials, not API-key credentials.
additions.liveRelayHint: Relay WebRTC audio and DataChannel traffic in the proxy process. Inbound UDP must be reachable. Keep ICE credentials out of screenshots and logs.

routingSessionAffinitySubagents.label: Subagent session affinity
routingSessionAffinitySubagents.hint: Enabled by default; only effective when session affinity is enabled. Subagents inherit their parent's credential to reuse caches. Disable to distribute subagents across the credential pool for greater concurrency.

saveCooldownStatus.label: Persist cooldown status
saveCooldownStatus.hint: Save per-credential cooldown status in .cds files beside auth files. Disabled by default; otherwise status is kept only in memory.

transientErrorCooldownSeconds.label: Transient error cooldown (seconds)
transientErrorCooldownSeconds.hint: Cooldown for upstream 408/500/502/503/504/520–526 errors. 0 uses the default 60 seconds; a negative value disables this cooldown.

videoResultAuthCacheTTL.label: Video result credential cache TTL
videoResultAuthCacheTTL.hint: How long video IDs remain bound to the credential that created them. Use a duration such as 30m or 3h; default: 3h.

claudeHeaderTimezone.label: Fallback timezone
claudeHeaderTimezone.hint: IANA timezone for the cloaked currentDate, e.g. Asia/Singapore, or Local for the backend host's timezone. The credential JSON's timezone takes priority.

claudeModelLevelCooling.label: Model-level cooldown
claudeModelLevelCooling.hint: Apply Claude quota cooldowns only to the requested model, rather than all models sharing the credential. Disabled by default.

claudeDisableCloakMode.label: Disable request cloaking
claudeDisableCloakMode.hint: Disable the Claude Code CLI disguise and system prompt replacement; pass through the original system prompt. Credential files can override this with cloak_mode. Default: false (automatic cloaking for non-Claude-Code clients).

claudeCodeDisableCloakingModelList.label: Disable model ID cloaking
claudeCodeDisableCloakingModelList.hint: Return original model IDs in Anthropic model list responses instead of cloaked IDs. Disabled by default.

codexDisableCloaking.label: Disable request cloaking
codexDisableCloaking.hint: Stop forcing official Codex User-Agent and Originator headers on HTTP/SSE and WebSocket requests. Disabled by default.

codexModelLevelCooling.label: Model-level cooldown
codexModelLevelCooling.hint: Apply usage_limit_reached quota cooldowns only to the requested model, rather than all models sharing the credential. Disabled by default.

codexStreamBootstrapBuffering.label: Buffer stream bootstrap
codexStreamBootstrapBuffering.hint: Hold initial empty events and heartbeats to allow credential failover on early overload or rate-limit rejections. Disabled by default. Delays response headers and may trigger client or reverse-proxy timeouts; buffering has frame and byte budgets.

codexStreamBootstrapTimeout.label: Stream bootstrap timeout
codexStreamBootstrapTimeout.hint: Optional buffering time limit, e.g. 20s. Default: 0 (unlimited time; frame and byte budgets still apply). Checked as upstream frames arrive; not a hard deadline for every network stall. Headers may still wait for translated output.

codexOptimizeMultiAgentV2.label: Optimize multi-agent v2
codexOptimizeMultiAgentV2.hint: Optimize official Codex multi-agent requests: refresh spawn_agent model details, remove message parameter encryption, normalize agent_message content, and convert it to user messages for non-Codex protocols. Disabled by default.

codexOrphanDelegationCompatibility.label: Orphan delegation compatibility
codexOrphanDelegationCompatibility.hint: For X-Openai-Subagent: collab_spawn requests, convert orphan codex_app/create_thread and codex_app/send_message_to_thread outputs without a valid matching call into user messages. Disabled by default.

codexResponseSteering.label: Response steering
codexResponseSteering.hint: Experimental full-duplex Codex Responses WebSockets. Each socket stays bound to one upstream account and model; accepted input is never replayed. Disabled by default.

antigravityConnectionPoolEnabled.label: Enable connection pooling
antigravityConnectionPoolEnabled.hint: Reuse upstream HTTP/1.1 connections. Default: false (short-lived connections).

antigravityConnectionPoolIdleTimeout.label: Idle connection timeout
antigravityConnectionPoolIdleTimeout.hint: How long idle connections remain in the pool. Default: 30s; capped at 210s. Zero or a negative duration switches to short-lived connections.

antigravityConnectionPoolMaxIdleConnsPer.label: Maximum idle connections per host
antigravityConnectionPoolMaxIdleConnsPer.hint: Maximum idle connections retained per upstream host per credential. Default: 2; capped at 100. Zero uses Go's default of 2; a negative value switches to short-lived connections.

xaiInjectXSearch.label: Inject x_search
xaiInjectXSearch.hint: Add xAI's native x_search tool when absent from the request, including tool_choice.allowed_tools when applicable. Disabled by default.

codexLiveMediaRelayEnabled.label: Enable media relay
codexLiveMediaRelayEnabled.hint: Terminate and relay Codex Live WebRTC media in this process. Requires inbound UDP reachability. Disabled by default to preserve direct media connections.

codexLiveMediaRelayMaxSessions.label: Maximum concurrent media sessions
codexLiveMediaRelayMaxSessions.hint: Blank or 0 uses the default of 32 sessions. A custom UDP range must provide at least two ports per session.

codexLiveMediaRelayDisablePrivateRemoteI.label: Block private remote IP candidates
codexLiveMediaRelayDisablePrivateRemoteI.hint: Default: false, allowing private candidates for local or trusted-network clients. Enable to reject downstream SDP candidates targeting private, loopback, link-local, or unspecified IPs and reduce internal-network exposure; local connections may fail.

codexLiveMediaRelayPublicIP.label: Advertised public IP
codexLiveMediaRelayPublicIP.hint: Optional public IPv4 or IPv6 address to advertise when the proxy is behind 1:1 NAT. Enter an IP address, not a hostname.

codexLiveMediaRelayUDPPortMin.label: Minimum UDP port
codexLiveMediaRelayUDPPortMin.hint: Set both UDP bounds to 0 for system allocation, or specify an inclusive continuous range with at least twice the effective session limit in ports.

codexLiveMediaRelayUDPPortMax.label: Maximum UDP port
codexLiveMediaRelayUDPPortMax.hint: Must be at least the minimum port. Both bounds must be 0 or both nonzero; a custom range needs at least two ports per session (64 with the default 32 sessions).

codexLiveMediaRelayICEServers.label: ICE servers
codexLiveMediaRelayICEServers.hint: Optional STUN/TURN servers using stun:, stuns:, turn:, or turns: URLs. TURN credentials are omitted from the JSON config API. Enter the credential as a password and keep secrets out of screenshots and logs.

spend.token_rate_hint: USD per million tokens. List blends published API prices using this row’s token mix. Rolling subscription rates use the latest 30 days / 24 hours, independent of the selected month: monthly fees prorated by calendar time, allocated within each account by API value, then divided by recorded tokens. Only accounts with configured plan fees contribute; missing usage can affect estimates.
spend.token_rate_partial: Less than 30 days of recorded history is available. Rates use only observed time and tokens; missing history is not estimated.
spend.token_rate_error: Rolling token rates are unavailable. Refresh to retry.
spend.title: Spend Analysis
spend.subtitle: Token-priced usage, allocated to the subscription that served it.
spend.unavailable: The spend recorder is unavailable for this server. Previously loaded totals, if shown, may be stale.
spend.observed_only: Calendar month in your local timezone. Allocations use recorded proxy traffic only; earlier usage and activity outside this proxy are not included. Current-month shares are provisional.
spend.gaps: Collection has gaps, rejected records, or is delayed. These totals are incomplete.
spend.api_hint: Published token rates × recorded usage; an estimate, not a bill.
spend.budget_hint: Sum of the plan prices entered for this month.
spend.allocated_hint: Plan fees distributed using each account’s API-cost shares.
spend.unallocated_hint: Configured fees awaiting usage or complete pricing; not unused quota.
spend.empty: No recorded token usage for this month yet.
spend.plan_help: Enter the fee actually paid for each account this month. Prices are saved on the Mac mini for this month, shared by all viewers. Leave pay-as-you-go accounts blank. Do not enter the same subscription fee twice for duplicate credentials.
spend.blocked: Some usage has no verified price or complete token breakdown. Allocation is withheld for this account so other models are not given an inflated share.
spend.unpriced_one: {{count}} request needs pricing or token data
spend.unpriced_other: {{count}} requests need pricing or token data
spend.formula: For each account: model API-equivalent cost ÷ account API-equivalent cost × monthly plan fee. Provider and overall totals sum the resulting dollar allocations. Quota percentages and request counts do not determine the allocation.
spend.assumptions: Rates verified {{date}}; USD per million tokens. Standard API token pricing is the benchmark, with 5-minute Claude cache writes. Higher published rates apply to long prompts (OpenAI >272K, Haiku 5.5 >100K, Grok ≥200K). Gemini 3.8 rates include its introductory discount through December 2026. Fast/batch tiers, regional premiums, cache storage, other tool and media charges, and taxes are excluded. Current rates are used for estimates, not historical invoices. Unknown models remain unpriced. The recorder uses a best-effort queue and cannot recover usage lost while it was offline.
spend.fee_needed: Enter this month’s plan price to calculate its dollar allocation. API-equivalent costs are available without a plan price.
spend.token_detail_hint: Token counts and their cost contributions. Output includes reasoning once. Allocated dollars are calculated within each account before being summed. Amounts show up to four decimals; rounding can cause small differences.
spend.token_partial: Known token counts are shown. Unpriced or incomplete usage is marked + ?; percentages are withheld until pricing is complete.
spend.image_input_estimate: The proxy combines text and image input tokens. This estimate uses the image-token rate for combined input and cached input; output uses the image-output rate.
spend.qwen_rates_hint: Qwen rates verified {{date}}: Singapore API list prices, with implicit-cache read rates and explicit-cache write rates. Max explicit-cache reads cost less than this estimate. Token Plan credits and remaining quota are separate from the dollar allocation.
spend.glm_rates_hint: GLM rates verified {{date}}: published API token prices are used for comparison and plan-cost allocation. Coding Plan credits and remaining quota are separate from this dollar estimate.
spend.deepseek_rates_hint: DeepSeek rates verified {{date}}: estimates use published peak token prices. Off-peak prices are 50% lower; time-of-use discounts and Search/Fetch fees are not included.
spend.image_rates_hint: GPT Image rates verified {{date}}: standard USD per million tokens, with separate text and image input rates. Image-output token charges are included. Cached rates apply where supported by the image generation tool.
spend.export_hint: Exports the selected month and provider, including hidden costs. Plan fees repeat per model; do not sum that column.
spend.terra_rates_hint: GPT-6.1 Terra rates verified {{date}}. Standard 30-minute cache writes; long-context pricing applies above 272K prompt tokens.
spend.quota_method: Each measured account has equal weight; availability is its lowest quota window. Missing history is estimated from recorded token activity, calibrated to current window usage; where that calibration is unavailable, recent burn or the current cycle average is used. Earlier account membership and reset cycles are assumed. Forecast uses the last 3 hours of observed burn and assumes known reset cadences repeat. Estimates are not measurements; API-only providers without quota readings are excluded.
spend.quota_unavailable: Quota collection is unavailable; historical observations may still be shown.
spend.quota_empty: No recorded quota history for this selection yet. Collection continues while this page is closed.
spend.quota_coverage: {{count}} measured accounts · hover for provider contributions
spend.quota_styles: Solid: measured · dotted: reconstructed · dashed: projected
spend.quota_warming: Projection needs fresh quota and at least two distinct readings spanning 5 minutes for every measured window.
spend.timeline_hint: Cumulative usage for the selected month. Each model has input, output, cache-read and cache-write bands in its provider’s color. Solid areas show usage to date; lighter dashed areas project to month-end at the last 3 hours’ average burn rate.
spend.timeline_partial: Incomplete token records or missing prices are excluded from the affected totals.
spend.timeline_warming: Forecast needs three hours of recorder coverage and a fresh collection heartbeat.
spend.sol_write_estimate_hint: Includes {{count}} estimated cache-write tokens. For successful Sol subscription requests with at least 1,024 prompt tokens and zero reported writes, all non-cached input is assumed to be written to the implicit cache. Shorter requests and reported writes keep their original split. This can overestimate writes; it is not a measured count.
spend.sol_write_original: Original counters preserved: input {{input}}; cache writes {{writes}}.
spend.sol_write_estimate_cost: Estimated writes use the published 30-minute cache-write rate, including the long-context rate where applicable. API value and plan allocations include this estimate.
spend.sol_write_chart_hint: Sol input/cache-write bands include estimated splits (sol-implicit-v1), also used in the forecast. Reads, output, and total tokens retain their recorded counts.
spend.quota_partial_forecast: Forecast uses the last three hours of burn data for {{projected}} of {{total}} accounts. {{held}} account(s) lack enough recent history and are held at their latest quota reading, without projected consumption or resets.
